android.desc:
Tired of unreliable GPS or pricey dashcams? Weel is the all-in-one app that combines trusted navigation and automatic dashcam recording, all from your phone!

Whether you’re commuting or on a road trip, Weel helps you navigate confidently and document every drive using your smartphone’s camera to record your trips and detect incidents.

KEY FEATURES
- Accurate GPS navigation with real-time traffic updates
- Dash camera that records every trip using your phone's camera 
- Optional in-cabin recording (ideal for pro drivers who may need to share cabin footage with their employer in case of a dispute)
- Instant reports, with trip info and video footage ready to send for insurance claims
- Secure, anonymized video storage

WHY DRIVERS CHOOSE WEEL
1. No need to buy an expensive dash cam with SD cards and cables
2. One driver app that combines safety, video, and navigation
3. Helps lower your car insurance by proving safe driving
4. Mounting your phone with Weel’s holder reduces smartphone use while driving by 30% and lowers the risk of accidents.

DOWNLOAD Weel now to protect your drives with a smart dashcam and get where you're going with accurate GPS navigation, all from your phone!
